questions.q: This sign indicates a railway crossing with a traffic signal.
questions.explanation: This is a sign indicating a traffic signal, not related to a railway crossing.

questions.q: Compared to manual transmission motorcycles, automatic motorcycles generally have a longer wheelbase and are less maneuverable.
When replacing a tire due to a puncture, it is best to do so on a flat, soft surface.
questions.explanation: It is better to replace a tire on a flat, hard surface.

questions.q: The first step in overtaking is to check if the location is not a no-overtaking zone.
In a designated horn-use zone, the horn must be used at blind intersections, blind curves, and the crest of steep uphill slopes.
With an ordinary motorcycle license, you can drive a minicar.
questions.explanation: A standard, medium, or large vehicle license is required to drive a minicar.

questions.q: There are four types of main signs and one type of supplementary sign.
If it is clear that no pedestrians are crossing a pedestrian crossing, you may pass without slowing down.
Motorized bicycles are not considered vehicles.
questions.explanation: Motorized bicycles are considered vehicles.

questions.q: To drive a vehicle with a maximum load capacity of 4 tons, a medium license (including a restricted medium license) or a large license is required.
questions.explanation: A non-restricted quasi-medium license is also sufficient.

questions.q: This sign indicates a designated lane for towed vehicles on a vehicle-only road, requiring towed vehicles to use the rightmost lane.
questions.explanation: Towed vehicles must use the leftmost lane.

questions.q: The signal for a U-turn must be given 30 meters before the point of the turn.
Attaching dark-tinted film to the windshield or driver/passenger windows, or modifying the muffler by cutting or using a straight pipe, is prohibited.
When counting passenger capacity, the driver is not included.
questions.explanation: The driver is included in the passenger capacity count.

questions.q: Private ordinary vehicles must undergo regular inspections every year.
When carrying children under 6 years old in a vehicle, the use of a child seat is mandatory.
If an accident occurs due to a passenger carelessly opening a door, the driver is not responsible.
questions.explanation: The driver is also responsible for such accidents.

questions.q: When placing a person on a truck bed to watch over cargo, permission from the police chief at the departure point is required.
questions.explanation: No permission is needed if the minimum number of people is involved.

questions.q: In the event of a traffic accident, the vehicle must not be moved until the police arrive to preserve the accident scene.
questions.explanation: The vehicle should be moved to prevent further accidents.

questions.q: The maximum speed for an ordinary motorcycle on a road with a speed limit of 50 km/h is 50 km/h.
This marking indicates approaching a safety zone or a restricted entry area.
questions.explanation: The marking indicates approaching a safety zone or road obstacle.

questions.q: Proceeding slowly means driving at a speed where the vehicle can stop within approximately 1 meter after braking.
Parking or stopping is prohibited within 5 meters of fire-fighting equipment, fire-fighting water tanks, or their road-adjacent entrances.
questions.explanation: Only parking is prohibited in these areas.

questions.q: Tire pressure should be checked by observing the deflection of the tire’s contact area.
Drivers must anticipate the worst-case scenario with a 'what if' mindset and avoid self-centered assumptions like 'it’s probably fine.'
This marking indicates a no-stopping zone, and vehicles must not enter if they are likely to stop within it.
Except for motorcycles, vehicle owners must secure a storage location for their vehicle within 5 kilometers of their primary place of use.
questions.explanation: The storage location must be within 2 kilometers.

questions.q: When parking in a time-restricted parking zone with a parking meter, the meter must be activated immediately.
Minicars cannot travel on vehicle-only roads.
Bus stops on highways can be used for parking or stopping outside of bus operating hours.
questions.explanation: Parking or stopping is prohibited even outside bus operating hours.

questions.q: This sign indicates a rotary (roundabout) ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign indicates a railway crossing ahead.

questions.q: When passing the side of a vehicle stopped at a pedestrian crossing, you must slow down before moving ahead.
questions.explanation: You must stop temporarily before moving ahead.

questions.q: With permission from the police chief at the departure point, cargo can be loaded on the truck bed or areas other than seats.
When braking on a motorcycle, it is better to disengage the clutch to utilize engine braking.
questions.explanation: Disengaging the clutch prevents engine braking.

questions.q: Rain is more slippery and dangerous at the start than when it continues to rain.
This sign indicates that motorized bicycles must perform a two-stage right turn.
When a traffic officer’s hand signal differs from the traffic signal, the hand signal takes precedence.
On steep downhill slopes, vehicles must proceed slowly.
When braking suddenly at 40 km/h on a paved road, the reaction distance is approximately 22 meters.
questions.explanation: The reaction distance is approximately 11 meters; the total stopping distance is about 22 meters.

questions.q: School buses must turn on their hazard lights when stopping to pick up or drop off children.
This marking indicates a safety zone.
questions.explanation: The marking indicates parallel parking.

questions.q: When the signal is yellow, pedestrians may begin crossing.
questions.explanation: Pedestrians must not begin crossing on a yellow signal.

questions.q: When driving, the seatback should not be reclined excessively, and you should sit shallowly on the seat.
questions.explanation: You should sit deeply in the seat for proper control.

questions.q: When there is a risk of roads freezing, it is advisable to sprinkle water in advance.
questions.explanation: Sprinkling water can worsen freezing conditions.

questions.q: In foggy conditions, headlights should be turned on early, and the horn should be used as needed.
Drivers must not engage in actions like revving the engine, sudden starts, or rapid acceleration that disturb others.
At night, headlights from your vehicle and oncoming vehicles may make pedestrians near the road center less visible.
When passing near pedestrians, vehicles must maintain a safe distance, but bicycles do not need to worry about this.
questions.explanation: Bicycles must also maintain a safe distance from pedestrians.

questions.q: On a flat, straight road, the stopping distance of an express train using emergency brakes is approximately 550 meters.
Within a railway crossing, shifting gears is prohibited to prevent stalling.
